start: Menu: Plans (address /plans), then a member's page; signed in as owner

steps.action: Open Plans
user_sees: Title "Plans", under it "What you sell, and for how much"; the button "+ Add plan"; with none yet: "No plans yet" and "Add your own, or start from a typical Indian gym price list and edit the numbers."
must_not: Plans of another gym; a retired plan offered for sale

steps.action: Tap "+ Add plan", type a name, a duration, a price, save
user_sees: The plan in the list with its price and length
must_not: Two plans from one tap; a price saved 100 times too big or too small

steps.action: Open a member with no plan and tap "Sell membership"
user_sees: Sheet "Sell membership": "Plan", "Starts on", "Plan price", "Joining fee", "Received now", "Paid by", "Reference (optional)"; the end date and the balance worked out as you type
must_not: An end date one day short or long for the plan; a balance below zero

steps.action: Pick the plan, leave the price empty (the plan's price), type what was received, save
user_sees: The membership on the member's page with its dates; a receipt for the money received; the rest under "Dues"; the header button now reads "Renew"
must_not: Two memberships or two receipts from one save; dues that do not equal price plus joining fee minus received

start: A member with a plan: "Renew" (another way in), and the first-time shortcut "Use a starter price list"

steps.action: On a member whose plan is running or ended, tap "Renew"
user_sees: Sheet "Renew membership", starting the day after the current plan ends (or today when it has ended)
must_not: A renewal that overlaps the running plan or leaves a gap without saying so

steps.action: Save the renewal
user_sees: A second membership under the first; the member's "covered until" day moves on
must_not: The old membership changed or lost

steps.action: On an empty Plans page tap "Use a starter price list"
user_sees: Button reads "Adding…"; five typical plans appear, each can be edited
must_not: Ten plans after a double tap; plans that can never be removed

start: Other kinds of change to a sold membership: "Freeze / extra days", "Change start date", and members' plan requests

steps.action: On a membership tap the freeze / extra days action
user_sees: Sheet "Freeze / extra days": "Reason", "What happened (optional)", "How many days", "Or type the days (1–365)"
must_not: Days added with no reason kept

steps.action: Add 7 days and save
user_sees: The end date 7 days later; no receipt and no dues change
must_not: A receipt or GST for free days; the price changed

steps.action: On a plan that has not started, open "Change start date", pick a "New start date", save
user_sees: New start and end dates, the same length as before
must_not: The length of the plan changed; a start date moved on a plan already running

steps.action: Open the card of members' plan requests (renew or pause, asked in the member app)
user_sees: Each request with the member's name, what they ask, and two buttons to approve or decline; once decided, a line saying so
must_not: A request approved twice; an approved pause that moves no date

start: Wrong values in the plan form, the sell sheet and the extra-days sheet

steps.action: Plan form: duration 0 or 500
user_sees: "Duration must be a whole number between 1 and 120."
must_not: A plan of 0 days saved

steps.action: Plan form: price "abc", joining fee "1e2"
user_sees: "The price looks wrong. Type it again." / "The joining fee looks wrong. Type it again."
must_not: "1e2" read as 100 rupees

steps.action: Sell sheet: a price above the plan's listed price
user_sees: A question first, asked once; a second tap on save goes through
must_not: A higher price taken with no question; the question asked again and again

steps.action: Sell sheet: "Received now" more than the total
user_sees: Refused with the reason on that box
must_not: More money recorded than the member owes

steps.action: Extra-days sheet: 0 or 400 days
user_sees: "Days must be a whole number from 1 to 365."
must_not: An end date moved by a wrong number

start: A sold membership: cancel it, then undo

steps.action: On the membership tap cancel
user_sees: Sheet "Cancel this membership?" naming the plan, with the box "Reason" and the buttons "Keep it" and "Cancel membership"
must_not: The membership deleted with its receipts

steps.action: Type fewer than 3 letters
user_sees: "Cancel membership" cannot be tapped
must_not: A cancel with no reason

steps.action: Type a reason, tap "Cancel membership"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"; the membership shows as cancelled; its unpaid dues are no longer chased; receipts stay
must_not: Receipts cancelled by themselves; the member still shown as active on it

steps.action: Tap "Undo cancel"
user_sees: The membership is back as before with the same dates and dues
must_not: Two undo taps making two memberships; different dates after undo

start: Who may change plans and memberships, and what the member sees

steps.action: Change a plan's price
user_sees: Memberships already sold keep the price they were sold at
must_not: Old memberships or old receipts re-priced

steps.action: Decide a member's plan request
user_sees: The member sees the decision in their app
must_not: The member told "approved" while nothing changed in the gym's list

steps.action: Open the member app as that member
user_sees: Their own plan, its end date and dues
must_not: Another member's plan; the reason typed for a cancel or a freeze, if it was meant for the gym only

start: Plans and a member's page, signed in as front desk

steps.action: Open Plans
user_sees: The price list to sell from; no "+ Add plan" and no edit
must_not: A way to change a price

steps.action: Open a member and tap "Sell membership"
user_sees: The same sheet; only the gym's own plans in "Plan"
must_not: A made-up plan the gym does not sell

steps.action: Pick a plan, type what was received, save
user_sees: The membership and a receipt with the desk person's name as taker; the rest under "Dues"
must_not: A sale saved with no taker; two memberships from one save

start: A member with a plan: "Renew" as front desk

steps.action: Tap "Renew" and save
user_sees: Sheet "Renew membership"; the new membership follows the old one
must_not: The old membership changed by the desk

steps.action: Open Plans in a gym with no plans
user_sees: "No plans yet" and "Ask your gym owner to add the plans you sell."; no add button
must_not: "Use a starter price list" offered to the desk

steps.action: Sell with a start date more than 31 days back
user_sees: Refused with a plain reason on the date
must_not: A back-dated membership saved by the desk, here or on the server

steps.action: Sell with a discount beyond what the desk may give
user_sees: Refused with the reason on the price box
must_not: A price far below the listed one saved by the desk

steps.action: Look on a membership for cancel, freeze / extra days
user_sees: Not there
must_not: A greyed button or an empty gap

start: A membership already saved, seen by the desk

steps.action: Open a member whose membership was cancelled by the owner
user_sees: It shows as cancelled; no "Undo cancel" for the desk
must_not: The desk restoring a cancelled membership

steps.action: Try to sell the same member the same plan again
user_sees: A new membership is possible; the cancelled one stays as it is
must_not: The cancelled membership silently brought back

steps.action: On a PT pack with sessions used up, read the note
user_sees: "Only the owner can extend it."; the desk can tap "Renew PT"
must_not: The desk adding free sessions

start: Limits the server keeps for a desk login

steps.action: Save a sale as front desk
user_sees: Saved: a new membership from one of the gym's plans
must_not: A desk login changing a plan, or a membership someone already saved (other than marking a PT session)

steps.action: Look at Plans
user_sees: Prices only
must_not: How much each plan earned
